name: os
description: Operating system, in the OCI/GOOS vocabulary (linux, darwin, windows).

name: arch
description: CPU architecture, in the OCI/GOOS vocabulary (amd64, arm64).

name: libc
description: C library ABI on hosts where os and arch cannot tell them apart (gnu, musl).

name: abi
description: The runtime binary interface a native file is built against, named with its family because a bare number cannot tell one runtime's ABI from another's (node-137 for NODE_MODULE_VERSION 137, telo-2 for the Rust controller ABI).
